title: Hotel Safe Reset
scenario: A staff member calls your room asking for your safe code to fix an error.

answers.A: Check inside the official app, booking, provider, or government site.
answers.B: Click/pay immediately to avoid losing the booking or offer.
answers.C: Ignore/report the message and use a known contact route.
answers.D: Forward it to a fellow traveller and ask what they think.

explanation: Hotel Safe Reset: the trap is to get access to an account, code, password, or permission. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to click or follow the risky request.
proTip: Hotel staff should never ask for your safe code.
